text:
incident-bot: URGENT: Pager - GPU cluster 'redwood-gpu-prod' at 100% capacity, HPA not scaling (metrics missing). Paging oncall-sre.

sara: I'm on it. seeing queue depth spike on the inference-queue service, ~820 pending requests, latency 5-10s then 503s.

alex: Confirmed. Autoscaler HPA target stays at 4 replicas but usage shows 0 for custom/gpu-util metric. prometheus-exporter logs show delayed pushes.

jamal: @sara can you check prometheus-adapter logs? last successful push was ~11:12 UTC

sara: digging in. kubectl logs -n kube-system prometheus-adapter-0 | tail -n 50

sara: ```
E0315 11:12:07.123 adapter.go:245] Failed to convert metric: queue_metrics/gpu_util: timeout writing to metrics cache
W0315 11:12:09.450 main.go:101] scrape backlog exceeded, buffer full
``` 

kevin: That matches what I saw in prometheus: there is ~45m scrape backlog, remote write errors to adapter. metrics-server looks fine though.

mia: Could be high cardinality from a recent rollout (new model-tagged pods). Check labels and scrape targets.

oncall-sre: Handoff from pager: I'm in zoom. Immediate mitigation options: 1) manual scale up GPU pool 2) restart prometheus-adapter 3) set static replica count for critical deployment 4) enable burst capacity on Dedicated.

support-lead: Customers impacted: enterprise-acct-42 and genomics-labs. Reports of 503s and timeouts for ingestion endpoints. Logged tickets: INC-1021, INC-1022.

customer-ops: Both customers show elevated error rates starting 11:08 UTC, spike peaked 11:20 UTC, still ongoing.

ml-runtime: If we can't get HPA metrics, we can temporarily deploy a lower-memory quantized variant of the model that fits more replicas per GPU. That reduces per-request latency slightly but avoids dropping requests.

infra-eng: I'm going to attempt a manual scale on the nodepool to add +4 GPUs: gcloud container clusters resize redwood-gpu-prod --node-pool gpu-pool --num-nodes 24

alex: Before that, try patching HPA to set replicas min=6 so it scales up immediately without metric: kubectl patch hpa inference-gpu --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'

sara: Doing the HPA patch now.

sara: ```
kubectl patch hpa inference-gpu --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"minReplicas\":6}}'
# patched
``` 

jamal: I see new pods starting, but kubectl get pods shows them Pending due to insufficient GPU resources. infra-eng, any ETA on manual nodepool resize?

infra-eng: resize API accepted, new nodes provisioning - ETA ~6 minutes.

oncall-sre: Meanwhile, restart prometheus-adapter to clear stuck buffers: kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n kube-system

kevin: Restart triggered. adapter pods restarting now.

mia: Also increasing scrape interval back to 30s -> 15s temporarily may create more churn; recommended to set to 45s to reduce load. We should reduce cardinality instead: exclude pod annotations we added in the last deploy.

ml-runtime: Rolling back the model tag changes would help. I'm preparing a rollback of the tagging sidecar.

support-lead: Customer comms: sending interim note letting them know we're actively mitigating and ETA ~15min for scale-up. Can someone confirm impact window length?

customer-ops: Current window 11:08 - ongoing (~22min). Errors ~18% of requests for those customers, affecting critical pipelines.

sara: prometheus-adapter logs after restart show success reconnect and metrics flowing again. HPA now sees gpu_util values.

alex: HPA changed desired replicas from 4 -> 10 based on metric. autoscaler starting additional pods.

jamal: New inference pods are Running and joining GPU pool. queue depth reduced from 820 -> 60 in 8 minutes.

infra-eng: Nodepool resized to 24 nodes. GPUs available. Manual autoscaling completed.

oncall-sre: Good. Next steps: 1) revert HPA minReplicas change once metrics stable 2) follow-up action to instrument adapter buffering metrics/alerts 3) postmortem.

kevin: Filing a follow-up ticket to add alert on prom-adapter scrape backlog and remote-write errors: TKT-2047

mia: Also adding a temporary guardrail: avoid deploying high-cardinality labels to exporters without review.

support-lead: Customer update: informed both accounts of mitigation and offered extended logging window. They acknowledge and will confirm if issues persist.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, start=1919002345, status=mitigated, responders=[sara,alex,infra-eng]

oncall-sre: Handoff complete to oncall rotation for monitoring through the next 2 hours. I'll prepare the oncall runbook updates.

sara: Saving logs and timeline, will attach to postmortem. Great team response, let's do the writeup.
